overview: Marginalia is an AI-powered formative assessment app for higher education that grades the thinking, not just the answer, by giving students Socratic feedback on their written answers.
features: Sign in with Internet Identity and choose a Teacher or Student role, with teacher approval before access
Student dashboard listing assigned tasks and a Reading Mode card
Answer Page with an answer editor and an AI feedback panel that returns per-concept status, evidence quotes, Socratic nudges and confidence
Evidence highlighting, a concept checklist with status chips and a weighted Understanding Meter
Version history with a Growth Timeline chart, a before/after concept diff and Submit to teacher
Teacher-overridable AI judgements with confidence shown on every judgement
